channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: 🎄 Merry Christmas from Navan Badminton Club! 🎄
item.description: Wishing our members, fans, and the entire badminton family a joyous and festive Christmas!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Navan Badminton Club: Christmas Send-off and Final Match of 2025
item.description: Join Navan Badminton Club for a thrilling Christmas send-off with our last match of the year. Play Thursday, party Friday, and celebrate with your jolly badminton crew!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🎄 Last Club Night Before Christmas at Claremont 🎄
item.description: Join us for the final Club Night of 2024 at Claremont. Enjoy exciting matches, open courts, and celebrate with friends.
